title: BAGMAN EvidenceClassification
description: An immutable, append-only classification of an EvidenceItem's document_type (CD-6 Slice 5 WI-1 — see services.evidence.classification's own module docstring). A classification row is NEVER a mutation of the EvidenceItem it references (evidence_id is a real reference, never a hard ownership/foreign column added to evidence_items itself); a row is created once and never updated in place — a correction is always a brand new row whose own supersedes_classification_id points back at the row it replaces. There is deliberately no is_current/SUPERSEDED status value anywhere in this schema: the 'current classification' for a given (evidence_id, classification_type) is defined structurally as the row no OTHER row's supersedes_classification_id points at (a real query, never a stored flag) — see services.evidence.classification.EvidenceClassificationRepository.get_current_classification.

classification_id.description: Canonical BAGMAN identifier for this classification row.

evidence_id.description: The EvidenceItem this classification is ABOUT — a real reference, proven to exist at creation time, but never a hard ownership column added to evidence_items itself.

classification_type.description: Deliberately OPEN (NOT a closed enum) so a future classification dimension beyond 'what kind of document is this' never needs a contract migration to be added. Only one value is registered in V1: 'DOCUMENT_TYPE' — enforced at the Python layer (services.evidence.classification.validate_classification_fields_or_raise), not by this schema.

document_type.description: The closed V1 document-type vocabulary. 'UNKNOWN' is a real, valid classification outcome (never treated as 'no classification exists') — see the status-conditional rules below for exactly when it is required vs. forbidden.

status.description: Exactly three values — deliberately NO 'SUPERSEDED' value (supersession is expressed structurally via supersedes_classification_id, never as a status). 'CLASSIFIED' requires document_type != 'UNKNOWN'. 'UNCLASSIFIABLE' requires document_type == 'UNKNOWN'. 'REVIEW_REQUIRED' allows document_type to be any valid value (a concrete type or 'UNKNOWN') with no additional constraint. There is no persisted needs_operator_review field anywhere — it is derived (status == 'REVIEW_REQUIRED') at a later layer, never stored.

source.description: Who/what produced this classification. Each value carries its own closed cross-field reference/confidence shape — see the conditional rules below.

confidence.description: Non-null and in [0.0, 1.0] ONLY when source == 'AI_PROPOSAL'; null for every other source. Never a manufactured value — a DETERMINISTIC_RULE match is never assigned a fake confidence of 1.0.

rule_id.description: The EvidenceClassificationRule that produced this classification — non-null ONLY when source == 'DETERMINISTIC_RULE'; null for every other source.

ai_invocation_id.description: The AIInvocation that produced this classification (must have status == 'SUCCEEDED', enforced at the Python layer) — non-null ONLY when source == 'AI_PROPOSAL'; null for every other source.

operator_action_id.description: An identifier for the specific operator action that produced this classification — non-null (non-empty string) ONLY when source == 'OPERATOR_ASSIGNED'; null for every other source.

reason_codes.description: Bounded short machine reason codes explaining this outcome (e.g. what drove a REVIEW_REQUIRED/UNCLASSIFIABLE result) — may be empty. Must NEVER carry raw extracted document body content; V1 does not enforce a closed vocabulary or a length bound beyond 'a list of strings'.

supersedes_classification_id.description: The prior classification row (of the SAME evidence_id + classification_type — enforced at the repository layer, not expressible by this schema alone) this row corrects. Null for the first classification in a lineage. At most one row may ever supersede a given classification_id (branch prevention, enforced at the repository/database layer).

created_at.description: UTC timestamp this row was created. There is no updated_at — rows are immutable after insert.

allOf.description: status == CLASSIFIED requires document_type != UNKNOWN (CD-6 Slice 5 WI-1's own status/document_type invariant, mirroring the mailbox_domain_rule contract's own match_mode-conditional allOf/if/then style).
source == DETERMINISTIC_RULE requires a real rule_id, and forbids ai_invocation_id/operator_action_id/confidence — never manufacture a confidence value for a deterministic rule match.
source == AI_PROPOSAL requires a real ai_invocation_id and a real confidence in [0.0, 1.0], and forbids rule_id/operator_action_id.
source == OPERATOR_ASSIGNED requires a real, non-empty operator_action_id, and forbids rule_id/ai_invocation_id/confidence.
